C204.notes: SER NA-TT-001. Photo confirmed · user shorthand 2014 25. Obverse arms · Scarlet Ibis + Cocrico · REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO · 2014 (denom on reverse — user: 25). Caribbean pocket change — maxi-taxi / doubles / market. Country #33 — first Trinidad and Tobago; Caribbean after Jamaica C069 / East Caribbean C159 / Cayman C185–C186. SER sibling: NA-TT-002. Trinidad and Tobago flips now 2.

open_questions: Type catalogued KM#33 for Trinidad and Tobago 25 cents 2014, but hobbyofkings and coins.lt list the Republic 25 cents (1976-2016) as KM#32. Verify.

Cosmetic: the design note describes the Scarlet Ibis and Cocrico (the coat-of-arms supporters on the obverse) but omits the actual reverse motif, which references give as the Chaconia flower. Fix when the record is next touched.

C204.story: A 2014 25-cent coin from Trinidad and Tobago. The front shows the national coat of arms, held up by a scarlet ibis and a cocrico, the two national birds, with the words REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO; the value is on the back. Struck in cupronickel.

C207.story: A 2016 10-cent coin from Trinidad and Tobago. The front shows the national coat of arms, held up by a scarlet ibis and a cocrico, the two national birds, with the words REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO; the value is on the back. Struck in silver-coloured metal (the record gives copper-nickel or nickel-plated steel).
